about: Peer sets chosen by what companies make, where the SEC's industry code is a poor market boundary. Every quote is word for word from the filing named, and scripts/source/fetch-peer-sets.mjs checks each one, each company's filing record, and each full-text search result against EDGAR before writing anything. Research: docs/implementation-notes/studio-research-workspace-progress.md, 2026-09-13, R7.
